FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 317
Committee: County and Municipal Sponsor: Representative Phillip Pettus
Government
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 04/18/2023
House Bill 317as introduced would increase the obligations of county and municipal
governments by an undetermined amount dependent on the cost to purchase up to two years of
service credit with the Retirement Systems of Alabama for certain law enforcement officers and
firefighters who are injured in the line of duty and received benefits pursuant to the Alabama
Workers' Compensation Act, as provided by this bill.
The actuary of the Retirement Systems of Alabama is unable to determine the potential cost to a
county or municipal government.
